package.name: library-of-evosmos-bibliographic-data
package.author: Chara Samothrakitou
package.notes: The emergence of the World Wide Web strongly influenced the Libraries, which until then were the main source of knowledge and information. The transition from the Web to the Semantic Web has solved many significant problems related to the supply of enhanced information to the end user. The opening and interconnection of data provided by the use of Semantic Web technologies allows the direct use of the data information offered by the libraries. This thesis examines methods that semantically describe bibliographic data and present these to the end user as Linked Data. In particular, the bibliographic data of the Public Library of Evosmos were transformed from the MARC format to the RDF format and were interconnected with the datasets of the Public Library of Veria and of DBpedia. Finally, this thesis can be a recommended practice for librarians who are interested in opening and linking the bibliographic data of the libraries they work in.
